Summer in Saint-Tropez with Jil Sander’s Leaf Fragrance

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:15
Instaread
Carine and Julia Roitfeld explore their memories evoked by Jil Sander’s Leaf fragrance in a video conceptualised by CR.
  • 08/18/2026
  • ‎ ‎‎ — CR Staff

Jil Sander’s signature fragrance line, Olfactory Series 1, takes inspiration in everyday ingredients and the strong emotional memories attached to them. In line with the house’s precise approach, each fragrance takes on only 3 natural ingredients. Each scent incorporates aldehydes, which work to reveal the pure ingredients’ nuances and give them a new expression. Nine talented perfumers designed the Olfactory Series, taking each fragrance’s core inspiration and transforming it into an aesthetic experience based on personal memories and experiences. This July, Jil Sander released six new fragrances within their Olfactory Series 1, expanding on their exploration of the links between simple ingredients present in our daily lives and the profound experiences they can evoke.

Created with Julie Massé, Jil Sander’s Leaf fragrance is a bright, green and sparkling scent which brings together key lime, cardamom and Indian cornmint to give the feeling of being in a Mediterranean garden. The result is a hyper-realistic scent of the fruit and leaves of freshly picked Black Krim Tomato, enhanced with the signature use of aldehydes.

Below, Carine and Julia Roitfeld reminisce on their memories of tomatoes summering in the south of France they connect with ‘Leaf’.
